name:
Curtain Bluff
*All Inclusive Resort*

address.street: Morris Bay St. Mary's Parish Old Road

insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary has been perfecting the art of understated luxury since 1961, where two pristine beaches meet dramatic Atlantic bluffs.
whats_special: Curtain Bluff is one of the Caribbean's most legendary resorts, featuring the rare luxury of two distinct beaches - calm Carlisle Bay for swimming and energetic Surf Beach for water sports. The resort sits on a 20-acre bluff offering panoramic ocean views, and maintains one of the region's most impressive wine cellars with over 25,000 bottles.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the Sea Grape restaurant - it's perched right on the bluff with unobstructed views of the sun melting into the Caribbean horizon.
dont_miss: The complimentary deep-sea fishing excursions (Curtain Bluff has won multiple sport fishing tournaments), the weekly manager's cocktail party featuring the resort's legendary rum punches, and exploring nearby Nelson's Dockyard - a UNESCO World Heritage site and the world's only continuously working Georgian-era dockyard.
pros: All-inclusive luxury resort with premium amenities
Stunning beachfront location on Antigua's coastline
Multiple dining venues and water sports included
cons: Higher price point for all-inclusive experience
Remote location may require longer transfers
